newsitem.title: NORWAY: DnB, Christiania shares slip after H1 results.
newsitem.headline: DnB, Christiania shares slip after H1 results.

text.p: Shares in Den norske Bank (DnB) and Christiania Bank og Kreditkasse fell on the Oslo Bourse on Wednesday after the two banks presented first-half 1997 results.
At 0925 GMT, DnB shares were down 2.7 percent at 32.50 crowns and Christiania stock stood at 27.70 crowns, down 3.2 percent from Tuesday's closing figures.

"Many investors are a bit disappointed with the results so they are selling," a dealer said. "Many feel the shares have increased a bit too much lately, so it does not come as a surprise that they are falling now."
DnB is Norway's largest bank and Christiania is the second largest.
